actors.rationale: Discover US YC startups with current hiring status and embedded open-job evidence, biased toward B2B SaaS and marketing roles. The returned openJobs will be checked for an exact or clearly equivalent growth-marketer role and the company record will be checked for seed-stage fit.

steps.purpose: Discover US YC startups with current hiring status and embedded open-job evidence, biased toward B2B SaaS and marketing roles. The returned openJobs will be checked for an exact or clearly equivalent growth-marketer role and the company record will be checked for seed-stage fit.

Resolve each surviving YC candidate by company name to a real LinkedIn company URL. This is necessary because the YC discovery output has no LinkedIn URL; the LinkedIn search result is used for identity only, not as proof of industry, size, or hiring.

Enrich the resolved companies with authoritative exact employee count, industry hierarchy, description, locations, website, and canonical LinkedIn identity so B2B SaaS, US location, and small-company fit can be judged against the mission and Brain.

Qualify and rank the enriched candidates against the explicit mission and Company Brain. Require US location, B2B SaaS business, seed-stage startup evidence, and a current open job whose title or description genuinely indicates a growth-marketing role; exclude Brain disqualifiers and retain the strongest 3.
Persist the final three qualified companies and their supporting identity, enrichment, and open-job evidence to the Workbench.
